note.windows: The first build takes 20 to 40 minutes and about 8 GB. Git, CMake, Ninja, LLVM, Python and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 3 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission once. Choose the folder holding your Vigilante 8 Arcade package (from an Xbox 360 hard drive or USB stick) or the extracted game with default.xex.
